ns2:section.sectionText: Exploring Social Issues Through Children's Literature. This course examines contemporary issues affecting the lives of children and youth as portrayed in current children's literature. Issues such as child abuse/neglect, violence, body image, teenage pregnancy, substance abuse, and prejudice/ discrimination will be explored through reading, writing, and discussion. Most reading selections are for adolescent/young adult readers because of the nature of the content. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to Freshman. Students should only enroll in one Discovery course.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Freshman class standing.
